Container.Name: skill-harvester
Container.Overview: Finds Claude skills (catalog plus the same creators' other GitHub repos), saves each whole skill folder, keeps the copies current, and scans them. Runs the service and its web window headless; open the WebUI. There is no login: keep the port on your LAN only. Optional: an MCP endpoint (port 18766, token) lets Claude on another PC search the live library.

Config.Name: Web UI port
Config.Description: Port of the window and the API (no login: LAN only).

Config.Name: Skills library
Config.Description: Where the downloaded skills, repos and backups (_backups) go. Big: use a share with room.

Config.Name: Working files
Config.Description: library.db, the job queue, logs, lists.json and settings.json. Keep this on cache/SSD.

Config.Name: GitHub token
Config.Description: A GitHub personal access token (public repo read access is enough). Raises the API allowance; without it downloads are slow.

Config.Name: Allowed hosts
Config.Description: Host names the window may be opened under besides localhost, comma separated (for example tower,192.168.1.10), or * for any.

Config.Name: MCP port
Config.Description: Port of the MCP endpoint (http://IP:18766/mcp) that lets Claude on another PC search the library. Set a token below.

Config.Name: MCP port setting
Config.Description: Turns the MCP endpoint on (empty = off). Keep it equal to the MCP port above.

Config.Name: MCP token
Config.Description: Secret that Claude must send as Authorization: Bearer TOKEN. Type one here yourself; without it anyone on the network can read the library through MCP.

Config.Name: Model server
Config.Description: Optional: URL of a llama.cpp llama-server (for example http://192.168.1.21:18888) that writes the model summaries of the About job. Text is sent to it, so use a machine you own.
